sentences.zh: 大卫·斯塔基在他关于年轻伊丽莎白的伟大著作《伊丽莎白的学徒生涯》中，将其描述为教堂和豪华软包牢房的结合体。

sentences.en: She's gone to a very luxuriously appointed chamber.
sentences.zh: 到处都是地毯。

sentences.en: So David Starkey, in his great book on the young Elizabeth, Elizabeth Apprenticeship, describes it as a cross between a chapel and a luxuriously padded cell.
sentences.zh: 墙上挂着挂毯。

sentences.en: So there are carpets everywhere.
sentences.zh: 还有一张巨大的床。

sentences.en: There are tapestries on the walls.
sentences.zh: 令人惊奇的是，我读到过相关资料。

sentences.en: There's an absolutely massive bed.
sentences.zh: 它曾属于在阿金库尔战役中被俘的奥尔良公爵的弟弟。

sentences.en: The amazing, I kind of read up on it.
sentences.zh: 你还记得吗？

sentences.en: It had belonged to the younger brother of the Duke of Orléans, who was captured at Agincourt.
sentences.zh: 记得。

sentences.en: Do you remember?
sentences.zh: 所以他是个俘虏，对吧？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的，永远的俘虏。

sentences.en: So he was a hostage, right?
sentences.zh: 他最终也用英语和法语写诗。

sentences.en: Yeah, forever.
sentences.zh: 但那是他的弟弟。

sentences.en: And he kind of ends up writing poetry in English as well as French.
sentences.zh: 奥尔良公爵的弟弟自 1412 年起就一直被扣押在英国作为人质。

sentences.en: But it was his younger brother.
sentences.zh: 所以他显然留下了这张巨大的床，这对他来说还挺好的。

sentences.en: And the younger brother of the Duke of Orléans had been a hostage in England since 1412 himself.
sentences.zh: 不允许任何男性进入这个房间。

sentences.en: So he'd obviously left this massive bed, which was nice of him.
sentences.zh: 所有的同伴、侍从、助产士，全都是女性。

sentences.en: No men are allowed into this chamber.
sentences.zh: 在这个纯女性空间之外，所有等待国王的男人们、朝廷、英国、欧洲，都处于极度焦虑之中。

sentences.en: All the companions, the attendants, the midwives, they're all women.
sentences.zh: 信件已经写好，准备向欧洲其他宫廷宣布这位被寄予厚望的王子的诞生。

sentences.en: And so beyond this very female space, all the men awaiting the king, the court, England, Europe, they're all on tenterhooks.
sentences.zh: 法国国王已经被安排担任教父。

sentences.en: And letters have been written, ready to reclaim the birth of what is hoped is going to be a prince to the other courts of Europe.
sentences.zh: 一场盛大的锦标赛也计划举行以示庆祝。

sentences.en: The king of France has been squared as a godfather.
sentences.zh: 但当然，最终这一切都被取消了。

sentences.en: A massive tournament is scheduled to be held in celebration.
sentences.zh: 没有全国性的欢庆。

sentences.en: But in the event, of course, they're all cancelled.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，确实，

sentences.en: There is no national rejoicing.
sentences.zh: 婴儿很健康。

sentences.en: I mean, it's true.
sentences.zh: 母亲也没有死于难产。

sentences.en: The baby is healthy.
sentences.zh: 但这些优点无法弥补一个令人沮丧的事实：这个新生儿，英国王位的继承人，不是个男孩。

sentences.en: The mother hasn't died in childbirth.
sentences.zh: 是个女孩。

sentences.en: But these pluses do not make up for the fact that it's a crushing disappointment that the newborn baby, the heir to the throne of England, is not a boy.
sentences.zh: 更糟糕的是，母亲曾向丈夫承诺会生个男孩。

sentences.en: It's a girl.
sentences.zh: 正如我们将要看到的，婴儿是否为男孩对父母之间的关系，乃至对英国历史都至关重要。

sentences.en: And what is worse, the mother has promised her husband that it will be a boy.
sentences.zh: 因为，当然，你还没提到父母的名字呢，汤姆。

sentences.en: And the baby being a boy has been central to the relationship between the mother and father and indeed to England's history, as we'll see.
sentences.zh: 是的，那是亨利八世和安妮·博林。

sentences.en: Because, of course, you haven't named the parents yet, Tom.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I know you've done that deliberately as an exciting reveal for the audience.
sentences.zh: 我知道你这么做是故意为观众制造一个令人兴奋的揭秘。

sentences.en: So, to explain why it matters so much that the child is a boy, that Elizabeth, and in fact, Elizabeth isn't a boy, we need to go back to the parents, don't we?
sentences.zh: 那么，为了解释为什么这个孩子必须是男孩，以及为什么伊丽莎白——事实上，伊丽莎白并不是个男孩——这件事如此重要，我们需要回到她的父母身上，对吧？

sentences.en: So, let's kick off with the father.
sentences.zh: 所以，让我们先从父亲说起。

sentences.en: Who's the father?
sentences.zh: 父亲是谁？

sentences.en: Well, the father, Dominic, it will amaze you to learn, is Henry VIII.
sentences.zh: 嗯，父亲多米尼克（Dominic）——你可能会感到惊讶——就是亨利八世。

sentences.en: And I guess he's the only English monarch who can rival his daughter for kind of instant recognizability, wouldn't you say?
sentences.zh: 我想他是唯一能与他女儿在辨识度上一较高下的英国君主，你觉得呢？

sentences.en: I would say not only instantly recognisable, I would say the single most important ruler.
sentences.zh: 我不仅认为他辨识度极高，我认为他还是最重要的统治者。

sentences.en: I mean, not necessarily the beSt.
sentences.zh: 我是说，不一定是最好的。

sentences.en: I think Elizabeth has a good claim to be the best, but he's the one that matters.
sentences.zh: 我认为伊丽莎白有充分的理由被称为最好的，但他才是那个至关重要的人。

sentences.en: The most consequential, isn't he?
sentences.zh: 他是最有影响力的人，不是吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, the most consequential ruler in England's history, and indeed in Britain's history, I would say.
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为他是英国历史上，甚至是不列颠历史上最有影响力的统治者。

sentences.en: So, when Elizabeth is born, he is 42, and he's a man of very imposing charisma and accomplishment.
sentences.zh: 所以，当伊丽莎白出生时，他42岁，是一位充满威严魅力和成就的男人。

sentences.en: So, he's been on the throne for 24 years since he was a very young man.
sentences.zh: 他从很年轻时就开始登基，已经在位24年了。

sentences.en: When he came to the throne, he was renowned as a kind of an elite sportsman.
sentences.zh: 他刚即位时，以精英运动员的身份闻名。

sentences.en: People went into rhapsodies over his athletic achievements.
sentences.zh: 人们对他的运动成就赞不绝口。

sentences.en: By now, he is starting to run to fat.
sentences.zh: 到了现在，他开始发福了。

sentences.en: He hasn't gone the full obesity, but he's still a very imposing figure.
sentences.zh: 他还没到完全肥胖的地步，但依然是一个非常有威严的人物。

sentences.en: He's poised between Damien Lewis and Charles Lawton, isn't he?
sentences.zh: 他处于丹米恩·路易斯（Damien Lewis）和查尔斯·劳顿（Charles Laughton）的形象之间，不是吗？

sentences.en: He's not quite one or the other.
sentences.zh: 他并不完全像其中任何一个。

sentences.en: So, he's got red hair.
sentences.zh: 他留着红头发。

sentences.en: He's very athletic.
sentences.zh: 他非常热爱运动。

sentences.en: He's described as having an extremely fine calf to his leg, which obviously matters in the Tudor court, where a fine calf is very important.
sentences.zh: 据描述，他的小腿线条极其优美，这在都铎王朝显然很重要，因为优美的小腿非常重要。

sentences.en: And the presence of Venetian ambassadors at the Tudor court is tremendous for historians, because they give very kind of detailed accounts.
sentences.zh: 威尼斯大使在都铎宫廷的存在对历史学家来说意义重大，因为他们提供了非常详细的记录。

sentences.en: So, one of the Venetian ambassadors described to Henry as gifted with mental accomplishments, as he's most excellent in his personal endowments.
sentences.zh: 有一位威尼斯大使形容亨利拥有卓越的智力成就，称他在个人天赋方面极其出色。

sentences.en: So, he's fluent in Latin, in French, in Spanish.
sentences.zh: 他精通拉丁语、法语和西班牙语。

sentences.en: He has very good Italian.
sentences.zh: 他的意大利语也非常好。

sentences.en: He's kind of got rudimentary Greek.
sentences.zh: 他还会一点基础的希腊语。

sentences.en: He's very musical.
sentences.zh: 他非常有音乐天赋。

sentences.en: Sadly, he didn't compose Greensleeves.
sentences.zh: 遗憾的是，他并没有创作《绿袖子》。

sentences.en: But he is a composer.
sentences.zh: 但他确实是一位作曲家。

sentences.en: He plays the harp, very good on the keyboards.
sentences.zh: 他会弹竖琴，键盘乐器也弹得很好。

sentences.en: So, that's very impressive.
sentences.zh: 所以，这非常令人印象深刻。

sentences.en: And he also fancies himself as a theologian.
sentences.zh: 而且他还自诩为神学家。

sentences.en: So, he had written a takedown of Martin Luther.
sentences.zh: 他曾写过一篇抨击马丁·路德的文章。

sentences.en: And the Pope had named him Defender of the Faith for this in 1521.
sentences.zh: 教皇因此在1521年授予他“信仰捍卫者”的称号。

sentences.en: And this is a title of which he's inordinately proud, and which the British monarch still has to this day.
sentences.zh: 这是他引以为傲的头衔，英国君主至今仍保留着这个称号。

sentences.en: So, it's the same the Pope.
sentences.zh: 所以，这还是那位教皇。

sentences.en: The Pope's let themselves down after that, didn't they?
sentences.zh: 教皇在那之后表现得让人失望，不是吗？

sentences.en: But we've kept the title, which is important.
sentences.zh: 但我们保留了这个头衔，这很重要。

sentences.en: This is, yeah.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: So, yeah, there's lots to come on that score.
sentences.zh: 是的，关于这一点还有很多要说的。

sentences.en: So, he's often seen, isn't he, as part of a trio of slightly larger-than-life monarchs who dominate Europe.
sentences.zh: 他常被视为统治欧洲的三位超凡君主之一，不是吗？

sentences.en: But of the three of them, he is the junior, isn't he?
sentences.zh: 但在他们三人中，他是资历最浅的，对吧？

sentences.en: The other two are Francis or Francois I of France, who's this sort of incredibly priapic.
sentences.zh: 另外两位是法国的弗朗索瓦一世，他那种极其好色……

sentences.en: He's a roister in his own way, isn't he?
sentences.zh: 他以自己的方式是个狂欢者，不是吗？

sentences.en: And then Charles V, the Habsburg Emperor, who's absolutely not a roisterer.
sentences.zh: 还有哈布斯堡王朝的查理五世，他绝对不是个狂欢者。

sentences.en: He is a very melancholy brooding man, but he's probably the top dog and then the French king.
sentences.zh: 他是一个非常忧郁、沉思的人，但他可能是老大，然后是法国国王。

sentences.en: Oh, undoubtedly, I think, because, I mean, he's the emperor.
sentences.zh: 哦，毫无疑问，我认为是这样，因为他是皇帝。

sentences.en: So, he's got Germany, he's got the low countries, he's got much of Italy, but he's also the king of Spain.
sentences.zh: 他拥有德国、低地国家、大部分意大利，而且他还是西班牙国王。

sentences.en: And, of course, Spain means that he's also the ruler of vast chunks of the New World.
sentences.zh: 当然，西班牙意味着他也是新大陆大片领土的统治者。

sentences.en: So, he's got all the silver coming in from the New World.
sentences.zh: 所以，他有源源不断从新大陆运来的白银。

sentences.en: So, he is overwhelmingly the most powerful ruler in Europe, I think.
sentences.zh: 所以，我认为他是欧洲压倒性最强大的统治者。

sentences.en: Then Francois, and then Henry.
sentences.zh: 其次是弗朗索瓦，然后是亨利。

sentences.en: But the thing about Henry is, he's very, very good at punching above his weight.
sentences.zh: 但亨利的特点是，他非常擅长以弱胜强。

sentences.en: You know, he projects this kind of vibrant image.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他展现出一种充满活力的形象。

sentences.en: And his weight is quite something, so that's pretty good.
sentences.zh: 而且他的分量确实不轻，所以这很不错。

sentences.en: And this makes him popular with the English.
sentences.zh: 这使他受到英国人的欢迎。

sentences.en: They're not embarrassed to have him as a king.
sentences.zh: 他们并不为有他这样的国王而感到尴尬。

sentences.en: They feel he, you know, he's giving them a good image, I think, is what they feel.
sentences.zh: 他们觉得，你知道，他给了他们一个很好的形象，我想这就是他们的感受。

sentences.en: I think that's the one thing that people always get wrong about Henry VIII, when they say, oh, he's a monster, he's this, he's that.
sentences.zh: 我认为人们在评价亨利八世时总是搞错的一点是，当他们说，哦，他是个怪物，他这样那样。

sentences.en: At the time, people in England, they might have been frightened of him, or they might have thought he was making strange and unpopular decisions.
sentences.zh: 在当时，英国人可能怕他，或者可能认为他做出了奇怪且不受欢迎的决定。

sentences.en: But nobody ever doubted that he was good at being a king, and that he was good at standing up for England, and that he, you know, embodied English independence and defiance
sentences.zh: 但没有人怀疑他是一位称职的国王，他善于捍卫英国，而且他体现了英国的独立和反抗精神，

sentences.en: and all of those kinds of things.
sentences.zh: 以及所有这些特质。

sentences.en: I mean, he's very good at it.
sentences.zh: 我是说，他在这方面非常出色。

sentences.en: He is.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: He's a massive great slab of beef on the English throne, and that's what the English like to see.
sentences.zh: 他是英国王座上一块巨大的基石，而这正是英国人喜欢看到的。

sentences.en: Like if Ian Botham was king of England.
sentences.zh: 就像如果伊恩·博瑟姆（Ian Botham）是英国国王一样。

sentences.en: Well, I think Ian Botham's called Charles Brandon, his mate.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我想伊恩·博瑟姆被称为查尔斯·布兰登（Charles Brandon），他的伙伴。

sentences.en: He is.
sentences.zh: 确实是。

sentences.en: Yeah, he completely is.
sentences.zh: 是的，完全是。

sentences.en: He's an absolute ledge, Henry VIII.
sentences.zh: 亨利八世绝对是个传奇人物。

sentences.en: But there's an issue, isn't there?
sentences.zh: 但有个问题，不是吗？

sentences.en: So he may well be a bit of a legend, and yet at the same time, he's a worrier.
sentences.zh: 他可能确实是个传奇，但同时，他也是个忧虑者。

sentences.en: He's insecure, and he's insecure for good reasons.
sentences.zh: 他缺乏安全感，而且有充分的理由缺乏安全感。

sentences.en: And this is the other thing that I think is, I mean, I think this is absolutely central to understand the whole story of the Tudors, why he has six wives,
sentences.zh: 我认为这是理解整个都铎王朝故事的核心，为什么他有六个妻子，

sentences.en: why he breaks with Rome, all of this stuff.
sentences.zh: 为什么他与罗马决裂，所有这些事情。

sentences.en: The fact is, the Tudors should not be there.
sentences.zh: 事实是，都铎家族本不该出现在那里。

sentences.en: They are usurpers, and we know the Wars of the Roses are over, the civil wars, but they don't.
sentences.zh: 他们是篡位者，我们知道玫瑰战争已经结束，内战结束了，但他们不这么认为。

sentences.en: As far as they're concerned, they could still be in the Wars of the Roses, because there are a lot of other people who think they shouldn't be here.
sentences.zh: 在他们看来，他们可能仍处于玫瑰战争中，因为还有很多人认为他们不该坐在这个位置上。

sentences.en: They're just parvenues.
sentences.zh: 他们只是暴发户。

sentences.en: They're nouveau riche.
sentences.zh: 他们是新贵。

sentences.en: What are they even doing on the throne?
sentences.zh: 他们凭什么坐在王位上？

sentences.en: Yeah, and so that makes it absolutely essential that every Tudor king has a male heir,
sentences.zh: 是的，所以每一位都铎王朝的国王必须有男性继承人就变得绝对必要，

sentences.en: because otherwise the throne comes up for grabs again, and civil war may break out.
sentences.zh: 因为否则王位又会成为争夺的目标，内战可能会爆发。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So Henry's father, Henry VII, had defeated Richard III at the Battle of Bosworth.
sentences.zh: 所以亨利的父亲亨利七世在博斯沃思战役中击败了理查三世。

sentences.en: His reign had been, there'd been all kinds of attempted coups, rebellions.
sentences.zh: 他的统治期间，发生过各种政变企图和叛乱。

sentences.en: Henry had put them down, and also he had done his duty by fathering sons.
sentences.zh: 亨利平定了这些叛乱，并且通过生下儿子尽到了他的职责。

sentences.en: So his first son, Arthur, dies at the age of 15, but it's okay because he has a spare, and that spare, of course, is the Henry who will go on to become Henry VIII.
sentences.zh: 所以他的长子亚瑟在15岁时去世了，但这没关系，因为他还有一个备胎，而那个备胎，当然，就是后来成为亨利八世的亨利。

sentences.en: And Henry not only inherits Arthur's title as Prince of Wales, but he also inherits Arthur's wife, Catherine of Aragon.
sentences.zh: 亨利不仅继承了亚瑟威尔士亲王的头衔，还继承了亚瑟的妻子阿拉贡的凯瑟琳。

sentences.en: And Catherine is the daughter of Ferdinand and Isabella, who are probably the most formidable Christian monarchs of their generation.
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳是费迪南德和伊莎贝拉的女儿，他们可能是那一代最强大的基督教君主。

sentences.en: I mean, that's a massive tribute to Henry VII's diplomacy.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这对亨利七世的外交来说是一个巨大的赞誉。

sentences.en: I mean, Henry VII, by the way, I think is a brilliant king, and he has managed to get a deal for his sons that they will marry this princess.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，我认为亨利七世是一位杰出的国王，他成功为他的儿子们达成了一项协议，让他们娶这位公主。

sentences.en: And he's punching above his weight there.
sentences.zh: 他在那件事上表现得超出了自己的实力。

sentences.en: I think there's no doubt.
sentences.zh: 我认为毫无疑问。

sentences.en: Because Ferdinand and Isabella, their reputation is well known across Europe.
sentences.zh: 因为费迪南德和伊莎贝拉的声誉在欧洲广为人知。

sentences.en: They're the people who sent Columbus.
sentences.zh: 他们是派遣哥伦布的人。

sentences.en: They're the people who have made Spain a united country.
sentences.zh: 他们是使西班牙成为统一国家的人。

sentences.en: They are presiding over a country that is rising to become a genuine world power, with all these holdings in the new world and stuff.
sentences.zh: 他们统治着一个正在崛起成为真正世界强国的国家，拥有所有这些在新大陆的领地等等。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, in a way, the first genuine world power in history.
sentences.zh: 是的，在某种程度上，这是历史上第一个真正的世界强国。

sentences.en: So this is a brilliant deal that Henry VII has got for, I mean, this is the mad thing about ditching Catherine of Aragon.
sentences.zh: 所以这是亨利七世达成的一项绝妙交易，我是说，抛弃阿拉贡的凯瑟琳才是疯狂的事。

sentences.en: You know, you've got such a great deal in marrying Catherine of Aragon.
sentences.zh: 你知道，娶阿拉贡的凯瑟琳是一笔多么划算的交易。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And also Catherine of Aragon is the aunt of the Emperor Charles V, who rules Spain as Charles I, because Charles V is the grandson of Ferdinand and Isabella.
sentences.zh: 而且阿拉贡的凯瑟琳还是查理五世皇帝的姨妈，查理五世作为查理一世统治西班牙，因为查理五世是费迪南德和伊莎贝拉的孙子。

sentences.en: And that kind of relationship between Catherine of Aragon and Charles V is going to play an important part in this story.
sentences.zh: 阿拉贡的凯瑟琳和查理五世之间的那种关系将在故事中扮演重要角色。

sentences.en: And just on this, so Henry and Catherine of Aragon get on really well at first, don't they?
